How early should I order a custom cake?
For regular custom cakes, 1–2 days in advance is perfect. For wedding and large two-tier cakes, please book 4–5 days ahead so we can plan your design properly.
Do you deliver in Sargodha?
Yes — we deliver across Sargodha, and you can also pick up from our Islam Pura location or order takeout. Delivery charges depend on your area and are confirmed on WhatsApp.
Can you copy a design from a photo?
Absolutely. Send us any reference photo on WhatsApp or Instagram DM and we will recreate it — colours, theme, message and toppers included.
How do I pay?
We confirm your order and final price on WhatsApp first. Payment details are shared there — you only pay once you have approved the design and quote.
Do you make eggless or small cakes?
Yes — bento cakes are made for 1–2 people, and special requests like eggless sponge can be arranged. Just mention it when you order.
